//: SCENARIO 1 of 3 — THE FALLEN HOUSE (restoration path). Fantasy: one poor holding, debts, contempt from those who rose past you; climb back. Treasury deliberately credit-poor (hooks 'the_lean_season' immediately). VOCAB FLAGGED FOR REVIEW (from §8 strawman): nature traits Proud/Vengeful/Just; aptitudes Strategist/Administrator; skills tactics/discipline/administration/charisma; ambition 'restore_house_fortunes'. era 'fractured_stars'. Confirm or swap when §8 locks.

houses.name: House Voss
houses.//: Credit-poor on purpose: starts near insolvency to trigger steward crisis events early. Materials/manpower survive from better days. TITLE: Baron on legitimacy 12 (Baron needs 25): the fallen house holds a title it can no longer carry — instant §13 soft-lock drama, vassals grumble, the contested-title web looms.
houses.title: baron

houses.name: House Harrow
houses.//: The risen rival who took what Voss lost — wealthier, contemptuous. The antagonist house. TITLE: The risen rival holds a County comfortably (needs 40) — their standing outstrips Voss's as much as their coffers do.
houses.title: count

characters.name: Aldric Voss
characters.//: Proud+Vengeful = feels the family's fall as personal wound (drives the §13 contempt-for-the-risen). Rank 1 already (a half-step up) so career events are reachable.

characters.name: Mira Voss
characters.//: Younger sibling, the steward to Aldric's soldier. Just+Administrator = the conscience and the ledger. A blood bond worth protecting (and a vulnerability).

characters.name: Senna Voss
characters.//: Aldric's young wife, married into the fallen name for love rather than advantage. The couple makes the dynasty layer live from turn 1 (births need a wedded mother and father). Younger than Mira so the sister, not the bride, stands next in line.

characters.name: Drusus Harrow
characters.//: The risen rival, outranks Aldric (rank 3 vs 1) — binds to 'a_rival_who_outranks_you' roles. Cruel/Ambitious, the face of the contempt.

relationships.//: The sibling bond — the protagonist's strength and soft spot.
Pre-loaded enmity — feeds rivalry/feud events from turn 1.
Drusus disdains rather than hates — he barely thinks of Voss as competition yet. Asymmetric, per the brief.
Wed before the fall; the marriage is the one thing Harrow could not take.

holdings.name: Greywater
holdings.//: One poor agri holding — barely feeds the house. Low yield, some unrest already. The single rung to climb from.

holdings.name: Anvil's Rest
holdings.//: Harrow's wealth engine — what a forge-world buys you, and what Voss lacks.

fleets.name: The Greywater Remnant
fleets.//: What the fall left: one tired squadron.
